description: This Java class defines a configuration implementation for monitoring settings within a MongoDB context, including methods for instantiation based on external configuration and overridden methods for equality, hashCode, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultMonitoringConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of monitoring configuration for MongoDB with methods to load from external config and override standard methods for object comparison and string conversion.

methods.name: DefaultMonitoringConfig.of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DefaultMonitoringConfig using a provided Config object to read monitoring settings.

methods.name: isCommandsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether command monitoring is enabled.

methods.name: isConnectionPoolEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the connection pool monitoring is enabled.
